scope: Independent source review of aggregate ETH/USDC routing, recovery/custody, ETH wallet workflow, standalone claims, trusted relay and public HTTP composition. No full G04 acceptance.

findings.finding: mkdir(mode0700) does not validate an existing state directory. The relay omits existing hosted main realpath/lstat/exact0700 checks before taking its file lease and reading/writing budget and signed plan journals. A writable or redirected state directory defeats persistence ownership and permits deletion/substitution of cumulative budget and operation records.
findings.requestedChange: Apply existing private-directory checks before lease/signer creation; reject unsafe existing modes and redirected paths. Cover actual open boundary.

findings.finding: A crash after durable budget activePlan reservation but before the first per-plan journal write leaves a reserved plan whose status returns absent. Submitting any plan remains blocked. Absence is not a truthful recoverability result for a retained reservation.
findings.requestedChange: Return unresolved for a matching active reservation with absent plan file; never clear budget or retry solely from missing file. Persist additional intent if automatic proven-unsent recovery is intended.

sourceAssessment: Portal depositFor binds beneficiary/executor/value/secret/consent nonce/deadline with standard computed EIP712 and SignatureChecker, retaining original deposit limits/ownership and withdrawal semantics.

Router binds EIP3009 authorization nonce to exact whole plan, chain and router; fixed relayer receives exact success-only fee and user receives exact refund. All conversion/deposit/approval effects revert atomically; pre-existing balances remain outside allocation.

Saved aggregate intent authenticates exact calldata/runtime/all three effects; USDC custody keeps beneficiary/random FPC salt separate from actual relayer transaction sender/nonce. L1 finality, private-node identity and L1-to-L2 witness checks remain.

Application revalidates claims on submission, uses existing encrypted once-only workflow, and composes collateral/Bok with fee mint-and-pay in the same L2 transaction. Standalone top-up actions reuse that boundary.

ETH wallet uses existing encrypted journal and backup domain, saves custody before send, archives original context before permitted successors, relinks the durable claim after a cut and requires explicit review after an attempted-before-submit cut.

Relay persists signed bytes before one broadcast, reconciles retained operations without retransmission, conservatively consumes cumulative gas reservation and refuses new plans during unresolved predecessor. HTTP has bounded body/time/rate and closed routes; raw errors are not returned.
